sections.text: Secret Art: Twisted Hues Petal Dance

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Deal magic damage (Time) 2 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Frail for 40 seconds with a success value of 120.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 120 seconds: Recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 120 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Heartless Collapse (increases Ability Powerof damage taken by 30, increases Ability Power of damage taken while in Break by 30, and increases Ability Power of damage taken from critical hits by 30) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000
